title: From domains to mechanisms of healthy psychological aging
title_zh: 从领域到健康心理老化机制
abstract: Healthy psychological aging has been consistently linked to patterns of behavioral engagement across everyday life, including cognitive, physical, social, and nutritional activities, alongside sleep. However, these domains are typically studied in isolation and conceptualized as additive risk or protective factors, which provides limited insight into how their effects are instantiated and maintained over time. Here, we propose a unifying framework in which diverse behavioral domains converge on shared psychological and neurobiological mechanisms that organize behavior across contexts and the lifespan. At the psychological level, motivational processes and regulatory capacity shape how behavior is initiated, sustained, and adjusted. At the neurobiological level, interacting dopaminergic, noradrenergic, and cholinergic systems coordinate valuation, arousal, and control processes, thereby translating motivational relevance into adaptive and flexible behavior. Within this framework, sleep occupies a distinct role as an integrative biological process that consolidates the effects of daytime engagement and feeds back onto motivational and regulatory functioning. By shifting the focus from domain-specific exposure to shared processes, this perspective provides a mechanistic account of interindividual variability and helps explain why domain-specific interventions often yield modest or transient effects. More broadly, it offers a principled foundation for understanding how behavior across domains is coordinated and stabilized over time in healthy psychological aging.
abstract_zh: 健康心理老化与日常生活中的行为参与模式（包括认知、身体、社交和营养活动以及睡眠）持续相关。然而，这些领域通常被单独研究，并被概念化为加性风险或保护因素，难以深入了解其效应如何在时间上被实现和维持。本文提出一个统一框架，认为多样的行为领域在心理和神经生物学机制上汇聚，形成跨情境和生命周期的行为组织。在心理层面，动机过程和调节能力决定行为的启动、维持和调整方式；在神经生物学层面，多巴胺能、去甲肾上腺素能和胆碱能系统相互作用，协调价值评估、唤醒和控制过程，从而将动机相关性转化为适应性和灵活性行为。在此框架中，睡眠扮演独特角色，作为整合性生物过程，巩固白天参与的效应并反馈到动机和调节功能。通过将关注点从领域特定暴露转向共享过程，该视角提供了个体差异的机制解释，并帮助说明为何领域特定干预往往效果有限或短暂。更广泛地，它为理解健康心理老化过程中跨领域行为的协调与稳定提供了原则性基础。
